description: This file defines a React hook 'useProgressiveExpand' and a utility function 'createProgressiveExpandController' for managing batch processing tasks in a non-blocking, progressive manner. It is used to process large sets of items in batches, yielding control back to the main thread to keep the UI responsive.

methods.name: createProgressiveExpandController
methods.description: Creates a controller object that manages progressive batch processing of items, with start and cancel capabilities, progress reporting, and fallback mechanisms for requestIdleCallback.

methods.name: useProgressiveExpand
methods.description: A React hook that wraps the controller to manage UI state (running, progress, counts) and provides methods to start processing from a set of items or cancel ongoing processing.
